# 🎙️ Audio & Video Transcription with Gemini

Turn interviews, focus groups, lectures and meetings into text.

**Run the steps in order, from top to bottom.** Each one has a ▶️ button on its left.

> ⚠️ **Before uploading research material, read Step 1's privacy notice.** These
> institutional notebooks require a billing-enabled project and any ethics/DPO approval
> applicable to the material. Regional Gemini API terms differ.

## Step 1: Prepare the notebook ⚙️

Click the ▶ button beside the code below. If Google asks whether to run this notebook,
check that you opened the ZMO repository, then continue. Wait for **Setup complete**
before moving on. You do not need to change the code or select a GPU.

Run each numbered cell in order. Some cells display a form: fill it in and click its
button before continuing. If you see a red error, stop at that step and read the message.
After a disconnected session, start again from Step 1.
# Generated by scripts/build_notebooks.py

## Step 2: Connect your Gemini API key 🔑

An API key lets this notebook use your Google AI project. Create one at
[Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/apikey). Creating a key and paying for
processing are separate: use the billing-enabled project required by Step 1.

Run the cell below and follow **Colab Secrets** instructions. Enable **Notebook access**
for each notebook separately. Never paste a key into the code or share it with anyone.

# ============================================
# STEP 2 — API KEY (Colab Secrets first)
# ============================================
key_panel = zc.ApiKeyPanel()
key_panel.display()
display(HTML(zc.api_key_migration_notice()))

## Step 2.5: Connect Google Drive (strongly recommended) ☁️

With Drive connected, completed segments are copied with retries and verified periodically.
Local checkpoints remain the primary copy while the runtime is active; always download the
final ZIP if the notebook reports that Drive verification failed.

You can also load big media files straight from Drive instead of uploading them.

# ============================================ # STEP 2.5 — GOOGLE DRIVE # ============================================ drive_status = widgets.HTML() drive_save_enabled = widgets.Checkbox( value=True, description='Save transcripts to Google Drive as they are produced', style={'description_width': 'initial'}, layout=widgets.Layout(width='460px'), disabled=True, ) drive_folder_input = widgets.Text( value=drive.folder_name, description='Folder:', style={'description_width': '80px'}, layout=widgets.Layout(width='400px'), disabled=True, ) def connect_drive(_button): drive_status.value = "🔄 Connecting…" if drive.mount(): drive_save_enabled.disabled = False drive_folder_input.disabled = False # Step 3 may not have been run yet, in which case there is no file # picker to refresh -- and that is fine, it will build itself connected. if 'file_selector' in globals(): file_selector.build_drive_tab() drive_status.value = ( "
" "✅ Google Drive connected.
" f"Transcripts will appear in My Drive/{escape(drive.folder_name)}/
" "The Drive tab in Step 3 is ready to use.
" ) else: drive_status.value = ( "❌ Could not connect. You can still upload " "and download files manually." ) def on_folder_change(change): try: drive.folder_name = change['new'].strip() or 'Colab_Transcriptions' except ValueError: drive_status.value = ( "❌ Use a folder inside My Drive; " "absolute paths and .. are not allowed." ) drive_folder_input.observe(on_folder_change, names='value') connect_button = widgets.Button( description='☁️ Connect Google Drive', button_style='primary', layout=widgets.Layout(width='230px', height='40px'), ) connect_button.on_click(connect_drive) display(connect_button) display(drive_status) display(HTML("
Saving options (available once connected):")) display(drive_save_enabled) display(drive_folder_input)

## Step 3: Choose your recordings 📁

Two ways to get files in:

- **From my computer** — fine for anything up to a few hundred megabytes
- **From Google Drive** — better for long recordings and large video files

**Audio:** MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, OGG, AAC    **Video:** MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, WEBM

Video files have their soundtrack extracted automatically, so you are never charged for
the picture.

# ============================================
# STEP 3 — CHOOSE FILES
# ============================================
file_selector = zc.FileSelector(
    dest_dir=FOLDERS['media'],
    extensions=ALL_EXTENSIONS,
    drive=drive,
    icon_for=media_icon,
    what='recordings',
)
file_selector.display()

## Step 4: Choose how the text should read 🎛️

**Start with Verbatim and automatic language detection.** Test a short recording first.

- **Verbatim:** retains hesitations and repetitions. Optional voice labels and word times.
- **Smart:** makes a reading copy by removing hesitations and resolving spoken corrections.
  It cannot include voice labels or word times. Keep a Verbatim copy for quotations.

Language is a recognition hint, not a translation request. For mixed languages, keep
automatic detection. There are no editable prompts, translation or meeting-minutes modes.
Use the Summary notebook afterwards if you need a summary of the transcript.

# STEP 4 — SETTINGS mode_dropdown = widgets.Dropdown( options=[('Verbatim — keep hesitations', 'verbatim'), ('Smart — reading copy', 'smart')], description='Text style:', layout=widgets.Layout(width='95%')) language_dropdown = widgets.Dropdown(options=[ ('Automatic detection / mixed languages', ''), ('French', 'fr-FR'), ('English (UK)', 'en-GB'), ('English (US)', 'en-US'), ('German', 'de-DE'), ('Arabic (Egypt)', 'ar-EG'), ('Farsi', 'fa-IR'), ('Turkish', 'tr-TR'), ('Hausa', 'ha-NG'), ('Swahili (Kenya)', 'sw-KE'), ('Other supported language', 'other') ], description='Language:', layout=widgets.Layout(width='95%')) other_language = widgets.Text(description='Other code:', placeholder='BCP-47 code, e.g. it-IT', disabled=True, layout=widgets.Layout(width='95%')) speakers_checkbox = widgets.Checkbox(value=False, description='Identify different voices') timestamps_checkbox = widgets.Checkbox(value=False, description='Include times for each word') vocabulary_text = widgets.Textarea(description='Names / terms:', placeholder='Optional: one unusual name or term per line (about 100 maximum recommended)', layout=widgets.Layout(width='95%', height='100px')) settings_note = widgets.HTML() def update_transcribe_options(_change=None): smart = mode_dropdown.value == 'smart' if smart: speakers_checkbox.value = False timestamps_checkbox.value = False speakers_checkbox.disabled = smart timestamps_checkbox.disabled = smart vocabulary_text.disabled = speakers_checkbox.value or timestamps_checkbox.value other_language.disabled = language_dropdown.value != 'other' settings_note.value = ( '

Smart edits the wording. Voice labels and word times are unavailable.

' if smart else '

Voice labels are anonymous, not names. Three or more voices are ' 'experimental (up to eight supported). Word times may reduce recognition accuracy.

' ) for control in (mode_dropdown, language_dropdown, speakers_checkbox, timestamps_checkbox): control.observe(update_transcribe_options, names='value') update_transcribe_options() advanced = widgets.Accordion(children=[widgets.VBox([ other_language, vocabulary_text, widgets.HTML('

Names/terms are ignored while voice labels or word times are enabled. ' 'Find a supported language code.

')])]) advanced.set_title(0, 'Optional: another language or unusual names') advanced.selected_index = None display(HTML('

Model: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe

')) display(mode_dropdown, language_dropdown, speakers_checkbox, timestamps_checkbox, settings_note, advanced) display(HTML('

Long recordings are split automatically without overlap. Voice labels ' 'restart in each segment; check voices and words at each join.

')) new_run_checkbox = widgets.Checkbox(value=False, description="Start a separate run") display(new_run_checkbox)

## Step 5: Preview and run / resume

Preview scope before sending data. Resume with the same source and settings to reuse completed rows, pages, or segments. Changed settings start a separate run. Batch jobs must be collected or cancelled before switching that run to synchronous processing.
# Generated by scripts/build_notebooks.py

## Step 6: Download, recover, and review

Download a recovery ZIP, including partial output, provenance, and resume state. Import it after a runtime reset. Re-select the original source to resume. The review panel keeps corrections separate from the original model output.
# Generated by scripts/build_notebooks.py

## Reading transcripts

Open `transcription.txt`; word times also produce SRT and WebVTT subtitles. Speaker identifiers restart per segment. `records.jsonl` contains raw text, timings, reviews, and stable source IDs.
print("Use the review panel above to inspect flagged units and source samples.")

## Optional: temporary files

Temporary audio segments and upload buffers are cleaned automatically. Keep run folders and recovery ZIPs while work is active. Colab removes local files when the runtime ends.
print("Keep your recovery ZIPs and Drive run folders until you have verified your results.")

## Help

- A run is identified by source bytes, model, prompts, and settings. Matching runs resume automatically.
- Each completed unit is saved locally. Drive synchronization happens at export checkpoints; download the recovery ZIP if a mirror fails.
- A partial, failed, or truncated unit remains eligible for retry. Keep the raw output for comparison.
- Excel formulas need cached values: recalculate and save the source in Excel or LibreOffice when preflight flags a missing cache. Generated cells are always literal text.
- PDF text-layer extraction is an explicit option. Inspect the samples first; the existing layer may itself contain OCR errors.
- Request and price estimates exclude retries, thinking, and provider-specific media tokenization. They are planning estimates, not billing caps.
- For CLI, recovery details, and evaluation, see [the project documentation](https://github.com/fmadore/zmo-ai-pipelines).
